about_item: PACKAGE INCLUDES: Set of 2 Halloween pillow covers, No Insert or Filler.Pattern is only on the front and no printing on the back. (4TH Emotion pillow cover can help you to change Halloween decorations quickly. also a super cute gift for your family and friends.)

SIZE: This pillow cover fits 18x18 inch insert, PLEASE NOTE: All of our pillow covers are made to ensure a snug fit. Each listing size refers to the pillow insert size and not the pillow cover size. To ensure the proper fit, we make all pillow covers slightly smaller (approximately 0.5" smaller) than the insert size.

EASY TO PUT ON: Color-coordinated hidden zipper closure brings an elegant appearance, and it’s super easy to stuff pillows/fillers into this pillow covers(Let it breathe for 24 hours – your faux fur pillow will become even fluffier and cozier).
WASHING TIPS: Machine wash in cold water separately, gently cycle only, dot not bleach.
MATERIAL: Made from 100% polyester with a soft plush texture and luxurious faux fur. These covers are skin-friendly, fade-resistant, and abrasion-resistant, adding an elegant touch to any space.

summary.text: Customers find the pillow covers blend well with existing Fall/Halloween decorations and consider them good value for money. The color matches expectations, and they fit pillows well, with one customer noting they slip right over regular ones. The material thickness and durability receive mixed feedback - while some find the material thin and say they won't last long, others report they've held up well. The zipper quality also gets mixed reviews, with some finding it sturdy while others say it's delicate.

authors_reviews.title: Great addition for Halloween
authors_reviews.text: These are such cute pillow cases. I love!Zipper is sturdy. Not a thick material with the exception of the little ghost which are more fluffy in texture. The kind of material that is comfortable to lay on. Could use them for bed decor as well! Good quality. I got 20x20. My pillows did not fit as a whole (cover and all) so I took stuffing out and put them in the ghost ones. Perfect fit.
authors_reviews.author: VGomez

authors_reviews.title: Worth it!!
authors_reviews.text: Literally bought these by mistake bc looking at a very small version of the pic I thought it was a blanket lmao.. but I actually love these! They fit great and are super cute and soft. Totally worth the cheap price. No weird smell or anything. Unsure ab fading since I just got them.
authors_reviews.author: Angel

authors_reviews.title: Cute & Spooky 👻
authors_reviews.text: These ghost pillow covers are SO soft and adorable for Halloween! 👻🖤 I’m honestly obsessed with them. They look so cute on my couch and the material feels really nice and cozy.One of the pillow covers did arrive with a small hole/tear near the zipper, which was a little disappointing, but I love them so much that I honestly don’t even care. They’re still absolutely worth it to me and such a cute addition to my Halloween decor!
authors_reviews.author: Stacy

authors_reviews.title: Soft, Beautiful, High Quality
authors_reviews.text: Both sides are incredibly soft! The value is out of this world also! The quality is amazing, color (beige) is beautiful, and HUGE bang for your buck on these. Would buy again, hands down!
authors_reviews.author: Danelle Picano

authors_reviews.title: Cute and festive
authors_reviews.text: So cute! I love the color options, and multiple sizing choices. Very soft and festive. Not sure how many seasons they’ll last, but they’re so adorable, and a great price! (18x18)
authors_reviews.author: TrishDishes

authors_reviews.title: Arrived with permanent creases
authors_reviews.text: They are really nice. Fit my pillows perfectly. Just wish they didn't arrive in an air tight bag. They have permanent creases that I am not sure will come out. I guess because they were cheap.
authors_reviews.author: Elena

authors_reviews.title: So freaking cute
authors_reviews.text: Do you ever just buy something you don't need, but it makes you smile? That is exactly what these adorable pillow covers will do. Fuzzy texture, cute pattern, decent zipper. They were exactly what I needed to brighten my day.
authors_reviews.author: Middlemarch

authors_reviews.title: You won’t want to miss out on these beautiful pillow covers
authors_reviews.text: These pillow cases are very high end, I love the softness of them. I only gave them 4 stars because they are hard to zip. The material is beautiful, thick and so soft, great value for the money and so far no shedding, exactly what I wanted them for!
authors_reviews.author: Andrea Spaulding
